title: AirCollections
tagline: AirCollections is the world's first live stream shopping platform for NFTs
description:
Engaging NFT collectors and buyers with creators has been challenging as current channels miss the lively connect. AirCollections is world's first livestream shopping platform for NFTs, which addresses this problem.

It helps NFT creators to engage with collectors and buyers with live video stream and allows people to shop NFTs during and after the stream.It is built using LivePeer live streaming technology and IPFS for NFT.

AirCollections allows NFT collectors and buyers to engage with creators in a live streaming show format. It is the world's first live stream shopping platform for NFTs.
how_its_made:
AirCollections is built using LivePeer livestreaming technology and IPFS for file storage.It also makes use of Metamask, Node.js, ERC 721 smart contracts for NFT. 



AirCollections uses LivePeer decentralized video infrastructure to allow NFT creators to livestream to NFT collectors and buyers. It uses IPFS for NFT media storage. Solidity is used to create ERC-721 smart contract and Node.js, REST APIs are used to create backend microservice.



Using LivePeer livestreaming technology as a developer was unbelievably easy! It allows us to innovate the video technologies at a breakthrough speed for a vastly improved NFT experience. IPFS allows us to create a trust with decentralized storage for long term NFT assets.



AirCollections takes the NFT industry in an unchartered and exciting territory with world's first livestream shopping experience for NFTs.
